# Camp Resource: Enclave Data Center

Nothing wasted!

Generates Electronic Parts

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Enclave Data Center__

**Produces**

Electronic Parts

- Power Relay Coil
- Fuse
- Sensor Module
- Enhanced Targeting Card

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resource

**Holds**

3 pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - Enclave Data Center - X Atoms

Atom Shop - X Bundle - X Atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 Minutes and 12 Seconds

**Lockable**

Yes

#### **Flamingo Units**

1 Flamingo Unit
